row: The Animal Rescue Charity YouTube channel provides a showcase of the Cats and Dogs in our care looking for new homes. Photographs go so far, but video provides an opportunity to actually see the living personality of the animals, their body language, and how they interact with humans. All are cared for and protected by us, but they have so much to offer people willing to give them a new, forever home.
